description: Identifies the format of one log record (access-log line, syslog/auth.log line, Windows event XML, CloudTrail, Entra ID, CrowdStrike, firewall, CEF/LEEF and more) and lists every field with what it means and where that meaning comes from (LogTriage's reference pages or the vendor's published definition). Decodes values: timestamps, address ranges, HTTP statuses, ports, logon types, NTSTATUS and AADSTS codes, encoded PowerShell. Runs LogTriage's attack checks on the record too. Free; no API key needed.

record.description: One log record (a line, a JSON object or one Windows <Event>). Up to 1 MB.

name: explain_log_record
title: Explain one log record field by field
